name: Market Scan
description: Pull multi-timeframe (4H/1H/15m) candles, EMA, RSI, ATR, volume ratio, range position, funding rate and contract specs for candidate USDT perpetuals (default top 15 by 24h turnover; override with --insts/--top).
args: optional --insts <comma-separated> / --top <N>; no args = top 15 by turnover
